<thought>We need the number of unique hydrogen environments for the compound, but no SMILES or structure is provided. The available tool proton_nmr_spectra may return the spectrum for the target compound if it has been pre‑selected in the environment, even without explicit arguments. We'll call it to see the spectrum and deduce the number of distinct proton signals.</thought>
